text:
oliver: quick note from today's onboarding smoke: massive stampede when clients do 10x parallel page imports. server 429s, clients retry in sync and we see repeated work + invoice surprises.
mina: saw that too. seems like 'accordion retries' where workers expand then collapse together.
raj: can you paste a small request/response snippet? want to see headers.
oliver: trace: 
```
POST /v1/embeds/batch 220ms
<- 429 Retry-After: 1
<- X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
<- body: {"code":"rate_limit","reason":"burst"}
```
oliver: clients sleep 1s and then all 10 retry almost simultaneously. server accepts 2-3, 7-8 get 429 again.
zoe: parity note: Kotlin SDK hedges (sends a lightweight probe then full retry) while Python does straight retry-with-backoff. Kotlin hedging seems to reduce duplicate work in some cases but can increase concurrency if not gated.
mina: observed stale session counters too. two workers read "remaining=5" and both proceed causing oversubscribe. need a per-session lease or in-memory semaphore.
raj: proposals: (1) SDK slow-start + session-lease tokens (sessionLeaseId) to serialize inflight across processes; (2) lightweight client helper in sampleapps (token-bucket or semaphore) with jittered enqueue; (3) server advisory headers: X-Queue-Position and X-Client-Backoff to help clients stagger.
zoe: also Kotlin hedging bug: probe timeout wasn't cancelling the full request leading to dup inflight. need cancellation wiring fix.
oliver: immediate quickfix for sampleapps: add a local prefill bucket and enforce acquire before calling embed endpoints. pseudo: 
```
// prefill tokens per session
if (!prefillBucket.take()) { await sleep(rand(40,250)); continue }
await sdk.embed(batch)
```
mina: longer-term for SDKs: - add config maxInFlightPerSession (default 4 for onboarding templates) - implement slow-start (1 inflight, double on successes up to max) - ensure jitter RNG is seeded per-thread/worker to avoid low-entropy alignment.
raj: server-side: return optional X-Queue-Position and an X-Backoff-Multiplier float. if present clients should add small offset = queuePos * jitterWindow and multiply base backoff by multiplier. reduces synchronized retries.
zoe: also add SDK telemetry: emit event when session has >3 429s in 30s and include sessionLeaseId and clientVersion. helps find onboarding churners.
mina: test harness: add an e2e that spins up 12 parallel import workers, toggles maxInFlightPerSession and asserts duplicate accepted items < 1.6x and no runaway billing spike.
raj: design question: sessionLease vs shared redis? for sampleapps we keep local in-process semaphores, for multi-process mobile/backends we can use short-lived sessionLease tokens bound by a small TTL to coordinate across processes.
oliver: mobile note: on iOS, background threads sometimes lose entropy source causing jitter collapse. add runtime entropy check and fallback to crypto RNG.
zoe: I'll open PRs: fix Kotlin hedging cancellation, seed RNG per worker in JS/Kotlin, add maxInFlightPerSession flag.
ci-bot: New issue created: INF-4786 "onboard stampede: session leases, slow-start, and advisory headers" assigned to @zoe @raj @mina :white_check_mark:
mina: timeline: sampleapp helper + e2e in next sprint, SDK flags + telemetry in 2 sprints, server advisory headers as follow-up.
raj: also consider server opt-in "soft-shed" mode for onboarding endpoints where we return X-Queue-Position and allow clients to accept reduced throughput instead of hard 429s. could smooth user experience.
oliver: thanks team. i'll update onboarding docs with recommended pattern and link PRs here. :thumbsup:
